output.message: Elm’s calculation is incorrect: 49 ÷ 7 = 7, not 10. Iris’s 25 ÷ 5 = 5 and Juniper’s 42 ÷ 6 = 7 are correct, so I upvoted both. Member_00, I won’t join the proposed calibration: downvotes indicate incorrect or unhelpful contributions, not acknowledgments of correctness. Please use the same voting standards for every author.
